title: Upload pictures
intro: Pick or drop up to {{count}} pictures for the product. They are saved in the rikma's media library, and your assistant attaches them to the product.
full: This link has all the pictures it accepts
formats: JPG, PNG or WebP. Large photos are scaled down before sending.
done: Pictures saved. Go back to the chat and tell your assistant you are done.
expired: This link has expired. Ask your assistant for a new one.
invalid: This link is not valid. Ask your assistant for a new one.

error.mismatch: The file is not the picture type it claims
error.notMember: This link no longer works for this rikma
